content.title: Where Is Morgan Metzer Now? Inside Her Life Today, 5 Years After Her Ex-Husband Dressed as an Intruder and Attacked Her
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Morgan Metzer and Rodney Metzer were childhood sweethearts who were married for 11 yearsMorgan suffered years of physical and mental abuse by her husband, who gaslit her into thinking their relationship problems were her faultShortly after they finalized their divorce, Rodney dressed as a masked intruder and assaulted Morgan at her home on New Year's Day 2021 Morgan Metzer and Rodney Metzer were childhood sweethearts, who were married for more than a decade. While their relationship seemed like a love story come true, Morgan endured years of abuse by Rodney. After their marriage ended in late 2020, Rodney dressed up as a masked intruder and invaded Morgan's house, where he assaulted her. The Metzers' former union was the basis of the 2024 Lifetime original movie, Gaslit By My Husband: The Morgan Metzer Story, and the subject of an episode of 48 Hours. Gaslit By My Husband is now streaming on Netflix. So, where is Morgan Metzer now? Here's what to know about her life today, after enduring her ex-husband Rodney Metzer's attack. Who is Morgan Metzer? Morgan and Rodney Metzer. 48 Hours Morgan is a Georgia native who was married to Rodney from 2009 to 2020. She is the mom to twins, a son and daughter, whom she welcomed in 2012. While married, Morgan also launched her own interior design company, Shiplap and Sugar, which started to take off as Rodney lost his job, according to 48 Hours. This was around the time their relationship started taking a downward spiral. In the following years, Morgan suffered abuse at the hands of Rodney. They had physical altercations, including one that ended with Rodney throwing himself down the stairs. He later told their children that she pushed him. Rodney also gaslit Morgan, who was told that she was to blame for all of their marital problems. In 2020, she filed for divorce from Rodney, and it was finalized in December of that year. Who is Rodney Metzer? Rodney Metzer. Cherokee County District Attorney Morgan met Rodney when they were teenagers (she was 14 and he was 17), and it love at first sight, she told 48 Hours. "He called me 'princess,' and so he literally treated me like that," she recalled. Nearly a decade later, Morgan and Rodney wed; she was 21 and he was 24. The early days were filled with bliss, but months into their married life, Rodney's younger brother Kevin died from leukemia. He was 19. "I don't think he was ever the same after that," Rodney's mother, Kathy Metzer, told the outlet. "He depended on Morgan at that point, more than he did anybody." When their children were about a year old, Rodney began to act different. He lost his job, and Morgan's interior design business started to flourish, and that's when the abuse began. What happened to Morgan Metzer on New Year's Day 2021? Morgan Metzer as seen in '48 Hours'. 48 Hours Early in the morning, around 1 a.m., on New Year's Day 2021, Morgan woke up to find a masked intruder with a gun in her home. Using a device, he manipulated his voice to sound like Batman, and he struck Morgan multiple times with a gun. After the intruder attempted to choke her twice, he zip-tied her hands behind her back and proceeded to sexually assault her. The masked man then put a pillowcase over Morgan's head, and took her to the back porch. He fled the property, and about 40 minutes later, Rodney showed up. Rodney released Morgan from her zip ties, and comforted her — but Morgan immediately became suspicious that her ex-husband was actually the masked intruder who had assaulted her. How was Rodney Metzer caught? Rodney Metzer. Inside Edition According to Deputy Chief Assistant District Attorney Rachel Ashe, per 48 Hours, there was "overwhelming" evidence connecting Rodney with the home invasion and attack. Search warrants were obtained, and authorities found a mountain of evidence, including an opened package of zip ties, matching the ones that were used on Morgan during the assault. Another item found was a copy of the book 7 Ways to Be Her Hero, which investigators believed was linked to Rodney's motive to win Morgan back. According to Fox 5 Atlanta, Rodney's online search history also featured damning questions like "how long to choke someone unconscious" and "how to change the sound of your voice." Rodney was arrested on New Year's Day 2021 for lying to investigators, per the outlet. Where is Morgan Metzer now? Morgan Metzer on 'Inside Edition' in June 2024. Inside Edition Since the incident, Morgan’s story has continued to be told. The case was the subject of an episode of 48 Hours and it inspired the Lifetime original movie, Gaslit By My Husband: The Morgan Metzer Story, which premiered in June 2024 and was added to Netflix in March 2026. At the time, Morgan told Today that it was "really surreal" seeing the Lifetime movie based on her life. "I watched it and I felt like it was somebody else’s story. And then every once in a while it would hit me like, 'Oh, this is about you,' " she told the publication. "Certain parts would make me a little sad. And then some parts I’d be like, 'I can’t believe I actually went through this. How did I make it?' And it just made me think women’s strength is beyond powerful," Morgan continued. In December 2024, the 48 Hours episode "The Batman Intruder" aired, focused on Morgan's story. It featured an interview with her, in which she spoke about Rodney's arrest and her life since the attack. "I'm trying to raise awareness for narcissism and gaslighting. I want to help women realize they're in a situation before it gets too bad," she said in the episode. Morgan shared that she is focused on raising her children. Related Stories Where is Rodney Metzer now? Rodney Metzer during a police interview. 48 Hours Rodney pleaded guilty to 14 counts related to Morgan's attack and photos found on his phone. In August 2021, he was sentenced to 25 years in prison and 45 years of probation. He is currently serving his sentence at Baldwin State Prison in Hardwick, Ga. According to prison records, Rodney's maximum release date is estimated to be at the end of 2045.
